name: AI Addendum
description: Supplements a product agreement when AI services are used, covering input and output ownership, model training, and AI-specific warranties.

coverPage.title: AI Addendum
coverPage.intro: This AI Addendum (the “Agreement”) consists of: (1) this Cover Page (“**Cover Page**”) and (2) the Common Paper AI Addendum Standard Terms (“**Standard Terms**”). Any modifications of the Standard Terms should be made on the Cover Page, which will control over conflicts with the Standard Terms.
coverPage.attestation: By signing this Cover Page, each party agrees to enter into this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
coverPage.attribution: Common Paper AI Addendum free to use under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

fields.label: Provider
fields.prompt: the provider's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Customer
fields.prompt: the customer's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.prompt: the date the addendum starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

fields.label: Training Data
fields.prompt: what data the provider may use to train its models, such as "Customer Content and Usage Data, once de-identified".

fields.label: Training Purposes
fields.prompt: what the provider may train its models for, such as "improving the accuracy and safety of the Product".

fields.label: Training Restrictions
fields.prompt: any limits on training beyond the standard terms. Usually none.

fields.label: Improvement Restrictions
fields.prompt: any limits on how the provider may use outputs to improve the product. Usually none.
